name: Arcane Destroyer (Warmage Archetype)
body:
An arcane destroyer uses fury to power their spells, as reckless as that may be. They are devastating on the battlefield, but can be an easy target by their enemies seeking to stymy the pure destruction they bring. They are not strategic, they are a blunt hammer of magic.

Charismatic Spellcasting (Ex)

An arcane destroyer uses their Charisma for determining their spells per day and DCs of their spellcasting. This ability modifies spellcasting.

A Lack of Finesse (Ex)

An arcane destroyer does not gain arcane strategies.

Spell Rage (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, an arcane destroyer lets the rage boiling in their blood to burst forth. They can spell rage for a number of rounds per day equal to 4 + their Charisma modifier. At each level after 1st, they can spell rage for an additional 2 rounds per day. Temporary increases to Charisma, such as that gained from eagle’s splendor, do not increase the total number of rounds that an arcane destroyer can spell rage per day. An arcane destroyer can enter a spell rage as a free action. The total number of rounds of spell rage per day is renewed after regaining spells.

When in a spell rage, an arcane destroyer gains a +2 bonus to the DCs and attack rolls of their spells for any evocation, conjuration, necromancy, or transmutation spell. Additionally, they gain a +2 bonus to caster level for dispel attempts and to bypass spell resistance as well.

However, while in the spell rage, the roiling magic energy makes them more susceptible to the spells of others, they take a -2 penalty to AC and saves against spells and spell-like abilities and they take a -2 penalty to concentration checks. The penalty to saving throws does not extend to enchantment, compulsion, charm, or fear effects. While in a spell rage, an arcane destroyer cannot use any Charisma– or Intelligence-based skill, except for Intimidate.

An arcane destroyer can end their spell rage as a free action and is fatigued for 1 minute after the spell rage ends. An arcane destroyer cannot enter a new spell rage while fatigued or exhausted, but otherwise can enter a spell rage multiple times per day. If the arcane destroyer falls unconscious, their spell rage immediately ends.

Spell Rage Power (Su)

At 6th level, an arcane destroyer adds 1/2 their warmage class level to damage dealt with spells while in their spell rage. This bonus only applies once to a spell, not once per missile or ray, and cannot be split between multiple missiles or rays.

This bonus damage is not increased by Empower Spell or similar effects.

Greater Spell Rage (Su)

At 11th level, an arcane destroyer increases the bonus to DCs, attack rolls and caster level checks to +3 while in their spell rage.

Tireless Spell Rage (Su)

At 17th level, an arcane destroyer is no longer fatigued at the end of their spell rage.

Mighty Spell Rage (Su)

At 20th level, an arcane destroyer increases the bonus to DCs, attack rolls and caster level checks to +4 while in their spell rage.
